name: Open-Faced Pesto Tofu Salad Sandwich with Tomato & Mixed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkgs fresh basil
6 tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo, nutritional yeast, and spices in a large bowl; whisk to combine the creamy dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup vegan mayonnaise
⅓ cup nutritional yeast flakes
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Finely chop pine nuts and add to the bowl with the creamy dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Crumble tofu with your fingers into the bowl; using a fork, mash to combine the tofu salad. Set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Divide bread between two baking sheets. Working in batches, place baking sheets in the oven and broil until bread is golden brown and toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper in another large bowl. Whisk to combine the vinaigrette.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp red wine vinegar
3 pinch brown sugar
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add mixed greens to the bowl with the vinaigrette and toss to coat.
To serve, divide toast between plates; top with dressed greens, tofu salad, and tomato slices. Season tomatoes with salt and pepper. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper
